verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at elevenlabs.io (HTTP 200), and the speech-to-text docs page is served as a .md version that points agents to a full page index at /docs/llms.txt. The llms.txt content itself covers speech-to-text API surface such as HTTP/WebSocket support and SDKs. Missing for 10: evidence of how deep the Scribe-specific coverage in the llms.txt index goes (e.g., a full-content llms-full.txt variant), and independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.
